lines.text: Many learners say: Despite of the rain, we played.
Better: Despite the rain, we played.
Despite is followed directly by a noun. Do not add of.
Despite! Despite the rain, we played football.

data.wrong: Despite of the rain, we played.
data.why: Despite is followed directly by a noun. Do not add of.
